queued: Saved on this device. Your submitted feedback is waiting for confirmation.
synced: Your submitted feedback was received by the playtest team.
draftSaved: Draft saved on this device. Press Send to share it.
failed: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. You can try Send again.
retrying: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. A limited retry is scheduled while this page stays open.
storage: This browser cannot save feedback on this device right now, so keep this page open. Next player on this computer can erase this device's Pecan Grove data and start over.
storageUnsaved: This browser is not saving anything on this device, so keep this page open. Next player on this computer starts over and keeps nothing from this player.
downloadFirst: To keep this player's notes, download Excel first.
recovery: Some earlier feedback could not be reopened. The original is kept for your instructor to recover.
changed: A new player started in another tab. Reloading to keep players separate.
empty: Your saved comments will appear here.
newConfirm: Start the next player? The next player gets a new game and an empty feedback form, and score sharing starts off again. This player's game stays saved on this device.
newRestore: Only Facilitator close-out, with the facilitator's code, can bring this player back.
newUnsaved: Start the next player? This browser is not saving anything on this device, so this player's game and notes will be gone.
newDownloadFirst: To keep the notes, choose Keep playing and download Excel first.
newNotes: Notes from this player that the playtest team has not received: {count}.
newChoose: Choose what happens to them before the next player starts.
newDeleteAsk: Delete them? Nobody can bring them back.
newDeleteYes: Delete and start the next player
newReview: Read this player's notes. Nothing is sent until a grown-up ticks the check and chooses Send now. When the playtest team has them all, the next player starts.
newStorage: This browser cannot save on this device right now, so the next player cannot start the usual way. You can erase this device's Pecan Grove data and start over. That deletes every player's game, notes and settings on this device, including notes not sent, and cannot be undone.
eraseFailed: This browser could not erase Pecan Grove's data. Keep this page open, or clear this site's data in the browser settings.
newFiles: Files were downloaded on this computer during this player's turn: {files}. Before the next player starts, delete them from the Downloads folder or move them somewhere private.
download: Excel downloaded for this player. Before the next player starts, delete it from the Downloads folder or move it somewhere private.
downloadError: Excel could not be downloaded. Keep this page open and try again.
removed: We removed things that look like contact details, names, ages, schools or birthdays. This check can miss things, so please read the note and remove any other names.
check: Grown-up check: I read this note. It has no names, ages, schools, birthdays or contact details.
checkStatus: Nothing is sent until a grown-up ticks the check and chooses Send now.
checkFirst: A grown-up needs to tick the check first. Nothing was sent.
blank: Write a note or choose an answer before sending.
flagged: Please check these words before sending: {words}.
notSent: Not sent yet. Your note is saved on this device. You can press Send to try again.
unsent: Your feedback has not reached the playtest team yet. It is saved on this device. Press Send to try again.
othersWaiting: Notes from earlier players on this device have not been sent. A grown-up can erase them in Privacy and notes on this device.
othersKept: Notes from earlier players are saved on this device for Facilitator close-out.
deviceOpen: Privacy and notes on this device
deviceIntro: For grown-ups. Read the privacy notice, see how many notes are saved on this device, or erase everything Pecan Grove saved here.
privacyStored: Saved on this device: each player's game progress, settings and score-sharing choice, the recent game steps of the eight most recent players, the names of files downloaded during the current player's turn, and random codes for the player and each note. If a saved record cannot be read, a copy of it is kept for recovery. No names or accounts are needed.
privacyNotesCloud: Notes are saved on this device while their player plays. At Next player, a grown-up chooses what happens to the notes the playtest team has not received: review and send them, or delete them. Notes the team has received stay on this device as they were sent.
privacyNotesCloudKeep: Notes are saved on this device while their player plays. At Next player, a grown-up chooses what happens to the notes the playtest team has not received: review and send them, keep them on this device for Facilitator close-out, which opens only with the facilitator's code, or delete them. Notes the team has received stay on this device as they were sent.
privacyNotesLocal: Notes are saved on this device while their player plays. At Next player, a grown-up deletes them, so download Excel first to keep them.
privacyNotesLocalKeep: Notes are saved on this device while their player plays. At Next player, a grown-up keeps them on this device for Facilitator close-out, which opens only with the facilitator's code, or deletes them. Download Excel first to keep a copy.
privacySentCloud: What is sent, and when: nothing leaves this device until a grown-up reviews a note and chooses Send. A sent note includes its text with contact details removed, the stop, rating and topic, the language, the game version, the times it was written and its random codes. With the notes goes a short record of that player's session: when it started and last changed, and whether it has ended, with the language, the game version and random codes. Scores are sent only if a grown-up turns on score sharing: with the notes they send, or as soon as a stop is finished if the second box is also on.
privacySentLocal: What is sent: nothing. This copy of the game is not connected to the playtest team.
privacyWho: Who receives sent notes: the playtest team, in a private Google Sheet. Notes travel through Google Apps Script, a Google service.
privacyContact: Questions about this play-test or about notes already sent? Email akeyvanf@kennesaw.edu and include the player code shown in the feedback panel.
privacyDelete: To delete what this game saved on this device, use Erase all Pecan Grove data on this device below, or clear this site's data in the browser settings. Excel and progress files you saved stay where you saved them.
privacyTries: So that nobody can guess the close-out code, wrong codes typed on this device are counted, without the codes themselves. Erase all keeps this count; clearing this site's data in the browser settings removes it.
deviceSummary: Players: {players}. Notes: {notes}. Not received by the playtest team: {waiting}.
deviceCloseout: Notes can be private, so this panel only counts them.
deviceCloseoutCode: The facilitator reads them in Facilitator close-out, under For grown-ups, with the facilitator's code.
deviceNone: No notes are saved on this device.
deviceCheck: Grown-up check: I read every note above. They have no names, ages, schools, birthdays or contact details.
deviceSent: The playtest team received every note on this device.
deviceFailed: Notes not received: {count}. They stay saved on this device. Try again later.
deviceLocal: Sending is not connected in this copy. Download Excel to keep these notes.
deviceDownloaded: Excel downloaded for every player on this device.
excelCheck: Check before sharing. Contact details and other private details were removed from these notes, but that check can miss things. Read every note before you share this file, and delete it from this computer when you are done.
erase: Erase all Pecan Grove data on this device
eraseConfirm: Erase every player's game, notes and settings on this device? This cannot be undone.
eraseUnsent: Notes not received by the playtest team: {count}. Erasing deletes them.
eraseKeep: To keep them, the facilitator can send or download them first in Facilitator close-out.
codeAsk: For the facilitator running the play-test. Type the close-out code to read, send or download every player's notes on this device. If you are a player, choose Not now.
codeWrong: That code is not right. Tries left before a one-minute wait: {count}.
codeWait: Too many tries. Wait one minute, then try again.
codeUnavailable: This browser cannot check the code, so close-out cannot open here.
closeoutIntro: Read every player's notes on this device before you send them. The Excel file has the notes with contact details and other details removed, but that check can miss things, so keep the file private and delete it when you are done.
closeoutChanged: Some notes changed after this list was shown, so it was drawn again. Read it again before you send.
closeoutFiles: Files were downloaded on this computer during this turn: {files}. Delete them from the Downloads folder before a child uses this computer.
restoreIntro: If Next player was chosen by mistake, bring back an earlier player's game and notes. The player playing now stays saved on this device.
restoreNone: There are no earlier players on this device.
consentScoresAsk: For grown-ups. Scores will be added to the notes you send: the stop number and score, with the language, the time and random codes. Never names. Scores already received cannot be taken back.
consentAutoAsk: For grown-ups. Each score will leave this device as soon as a stop is finished, without a review: the stop number and score, with the language, the time and random codes. Never notes or names.
unavailable: Sending is not connected. Your draft stays on this device.
scoresOnly: Score sharing is off unless a grown-up turns it on.
title: Playtest feedback
introduction: Tell us what you notice while you play. You can leave a separate note for each stop.
privacyLocal: Your draft and saved notes stay on this device. At Next player on this computer, a grown-up chooses what happens to them, so download an Excel backup to keep them. No name or contact details are needed.
privacyCloud: Drafts stay on this device. Ask a grown-up to review and send a note to the playtest team. Sending includes your note, the stop, the language, the time and random codes for this player and note. Scores are included only with permission. Never include names or contact details.
hint: A few words are enough. Please leave out names, email addresses and other personal details.
shared: Sharing this computer? Choose Next player on this computer before someone else plays. It starts a separate game and feedback session.
